errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.ROOM_FULL: That room already has two people.
errors.INVITATION_EXPIRED: That invite has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.INVITATION_USED: That invite was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.ALREADY_IN_ROOM: You're already chatting with someone in another room.

signIn.tagline: Chat with someone you like, and raise a tiny buddy together.
signIn.error: Couldn’t sign in. Please try again.
signIn.noAccountNeeded: No account needed. Guests can use buddy-chat for 30 days, and linking an account keeps everything.

welcome.title: A new buddy is about to hatch!
welcome.subtitle: Give it a name. You can invite a friend any time.

join.title: Join with a code
join.hint: Enter the 8-character code your friend shared.
join.leaveMessage: If you join this room, the buddy you're raising now and its chat will be gone.

chat.emptySolo:
{{buddy}} has hatched!
Invite a friend to raise it together.
chat.emptyDuo:
You and {{partner}} are together now.
Say hello!

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.hint: Share this code. Your friend enters it after signing in.
invite.shareMessage: Let's raise a buddy together on buddy-chat! Invite code: {{code}}

buddy.growthHint: The more you chat and take care of it, the more it grows.

settings.title: Settings
settings.leaveDuo: {{buddy}} stays with {{partner}}. You won’t see the conversation anymore.
settings.leaveSolo: {{buddy}} and your messages will be deleted. This can’t be undone.
settings.guestBody: Guests can use buddy-chat for 30 days. Link a Google account to keep your buddy and messages after that, or on a new device.
settings.linkNotReady: Linking an account in the app is coming soon.
settings.linkFailed: Couldn’t link the account. Please try again.
settings.accountInUseTitle: This Google account is already in use
settings.accountInUseMessage: It already has buddy-chat data. If you switch to it, the buddy and messages from this guest account won’t be available on this device anymore.
settings.guestSignOutTitle: Sign out of your guest account?
settings.guestSignOutMessage: You can’t come back to this guest account after signing out. Link an account first to keep your buddy and messages.
settings.notificationsBody: Get notified when your friend sends a message.
settings.notificationsDenied: Notifications for buddy-chat are turned off in iPhone Settings.
settings.deleteNoRoom: Your name and account will be deleted. This can’t be undone.
settings.deleteSolo: {{buddy}}, your messages, your name and your account will all be deleted. This can’t be undone.
settings.deleteDuo: Your name and account will be deleted and you’ll leave the room. {{buddy}} stays with {{partner}}, and the messages you shared stay with {{partner}}. This can’t be undone.
settings.deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete your account. Please try again.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: Your friend will see this name. You can change it later in settings.
